requirements:
requests
urllib3
simplejson
Pillow
pycryptodome
websocket-client
dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

CMD ["python", "-c", "print('XBMC Kodi Addon Container Ready')"]
explanation: requirements.txt includes common dependencies for Kodi addons (HTTP requests, JSON, cryptography, GUI elements). Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim for a lightweight base, installs requirements, and sets a default command. Note: XBMC/Kodi itself runs externally; this container would only handle addon-specific Python logic.
